sources.quote: charge per lead, not per click
sources.title: How leads work - Local Services Help
sources.evidence: With Local Services Ads, you only pay for valid leads (such as phone calls and messages) rather than ad clicks. Leads are first assessed when the potential customer makes initial contact, and leads determined to be invalid or low quality are not charged.

sources.quote: For eligible trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, cleaning and more)
sources.title: Getting started with Local Services Ads - Canada - Local Services Help
sources.evidence: Local Services Ads in Canada are available only for certain service categories, including appliance repair services, carpet cleaning services, cleaning services, electricians, HVAC (heating or air conditioning), junk removal services, lawn care services, locksmiths, movers, pest control services, plumbers, roofers, tree services, and water damage services.

sources.quote: Getting screened requires licensing, insurance and background checks
sources.title: Business screening and verification requirements - Canada - Local Services Help
sources.evidence: As part of Google's screening and verification process, businesses seeking to advertise with Local Services Ads are required to complete appropriate background checks and have appropriate licenses and insurance, as applicable. Background checks are required for select users in the US and Canada; insurance checks are required for select users in the US, Canada and EMEA.

sources.quote: Never incentivize or gate reviews; both violate Google policy and Canadian competition law.
sources.publisher: Google Maps User Generated Content Policy Help
sources.title: Prohibited & restricted content - Maps User Generated Content Policy Help
sources.evidence: Google prohibits offering incentives, such as payment, discounts, free goods and/or services, in exchange for posting any review or revision or removal of a negative review. Merchants are prohibited from discouraging or prohibiting negative reviews, or selectively soliciting positive reviews from customers.
